# Surface

## Select where to use your app

On the **Surface** page, select the Zoom products that this app works in. Users can open and use the app directly from these products. Note that some features may not be available depending on the products you select. Choose products such as Meetings, Webinars, Rooms, Phone, Chat, Contact Center, Whiteboard, Events, and Mail.

-   **Home URL** - Display the URL to your app's home page inside the in-client web browser.
-   **Domain Allow List** - Add URLs you want the Zoom client to accept.

## In-client app features

Select features to include for your in-client app.

The availability of the features depends on the Zoom products you select and your app's **management type**. The management type affects the features and scopes available to your app. If you change the management type later on, make sure you reconfirm the selected features and scopes for your app.

The following is a list of the features available to your app based on the app management type.

> **Local test**
>
> When performing [local testing](/docs/build-flow/local-test/) for your app, be aware that admin-managed apps are not displayed in the Zoom client. Admin-managed apps are managed through the web portal and are hidden from the Zoom client.
